none: PAS NLM-8D80EC: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, probably of House of Constantine (306-361), possibly Virtus Augg issue of 337-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [---]A[---]. Reverse description: Virtus standing with shield right and vertical spear left. Reverse inscription: [VIRTVS AVGG NN]. Diameter: 15.9mm, Weight: 1.41gms, die axis: 12
